links.comparator_used: ML-only extraction and fully manual abstraction by clinical experts
links.outcome: Data error rate versus manual abstraction effort for curated oncology variables
links.effect: Only small amounts of manual abstraction were needed to reach expert-level error rates; in some cases hybrid error rates were lower than manual abstraction. No numeric values are given in the abstract.
links.tradeoff: Needs reference-standard labels to calibrate confidence thresholds and the tradeoff between abstraction effort and data quality.
links.quote: Only small amounts of manual abstraction are required for hybrid curation to achieve expert-level error rates.

links.comparator_used: Uniform manual abstraction of all records by clinical experts
links.outcome: Error rate and manual abstraction effort when only low-confidence model outputs are routed to human abstractors
links.effect: The hybrid approach can reduce error rates relative to manual abstraction in some cases. A cohort defined with hybrid variables had demographics comparable to one curated conventionally. No numeric values are given in the abstract.
links.tradeoff: Reference-standard labels are required to calibrate the tradeoff between abstraction effort and data quality.
links.quote: In fact, the hybrid methodology can even reduce error rates relative to manual abstraction in some cases.

design_hint: confidence-threshold routing to human expert review
